## Data: TALIS 2018 South Korea

TALIS 2018 South Korea Data (BTGKOR3.sav)

```{r Data_load}

library(haven)
talis <- read_sav('/Users/seongminpark/Documents/GitHub/gganggang2.github.io/Personal Project/BTGKORT3.sav')

talis <- NO_haven(talis)
talis <- talis |> 
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::as_factor))

talis2 <- talis |> 
  select(TT3G34A, TT3G34B, TT3G34E, TT3G34G,
         TT3G01, TT3G03, TT3G11B) |> 
  mutate(across(c(TT3G01, TT3G03), as.factor))

colnames(talis2) <- c("se1", "se2", "se3", "se4",
                      "gender", "edu", "exp")

talis3 <- talis |> 
  select(TT3G34C, TT3G34J, TT3G34K, TT3G34L,
         TT3G01, TT3G03, TT3G11B) |> 
  mutate(across(c(TT3G01, TT3G03), as.factor))

talis2$gender <- factor(talis3$gender, labels = c("male", "female"))
talis2$edu <- factor(talis3$edu, labels = c("edu1", "edu2", "edu3", "edu4"))

colnames(talis2) <- c("se1", "se2", "se3", "se4",
                      "gender", "edu", "exp")

talis2_clean <- talis2[complete.cases(talis2), ]
  

talis_sem <- '
  SE =~ se1 + se2 + se3 + se4
  se1 ~~ se2
  SE ~ gender
'
fit_se <- sem(talis_sem, data = talis2_clean)
summary(fit_se, fit.measures = T)

# Tree

control_settings <- semtree.control(
  method = "score",        
  max.depth = 2,
  alpha = 0.05            
)

talis_tree <- semtree(
  model = fit_se, 
  data = talis2_clean, 
  control = control_settings,
  predictors = c("edu", "exp")
)

plot(talis_tree)
summary(talis_tree)
```

```{r google_Example}

bw <- with(MASS::birthwt, {
  ui <- factor(ui, labels=c("no","yes"))
  ht <- factor(ht, labels=c("no","yes"))
  smoke <- factor(smoke, labels=c("no","yes"))
  data.frame( bwt, uterine_irritability=ui, hypertension=ht, smoke, num_premature_labours=ptl, physician_visits=ftv )
})

model <- lavaan::lavaan("bwt~~bwt; bwt~1")
ctrl <- semtree_control(method="score", max.depth = 2, alpha = 0.01)
tree <- semtree(model = model, data = bw, control = ctrl)
plot(tree)
```
